title: Steel & Sunlight
description: A bright, bouncing four-on-the-floor house cut led by a plucky steel-pan-flavored melody that ratchets and reharmonizes as it climbs. It peaks early into a dense, funky groove, then deconstructs the lead into glassy fragments over a tight, dry TR707 kit before stripping back to a single arp.
